metadata.title: fix: hardening and behavior consistency across auth, import/export, and transport paths
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
Broad hardening pass across auth, import/export scoping, transport safety defaults, subprocess input validation, and provenance consistency.

## Included hardening updates
- A-13: plugin auth hook now reconciles user/admin identity against DB records.
- A-14: debug logging hardening removes credential-bearing fields.
- A-15: OAuth token storage model hardening tightened.
- A-16: tool-read responses harden auth masking behavior.
- C-42: plugin pre-request handling hardens auth-sensitive header precedence.
- C-43: IP token scoping hardening uses direct client address handling.
- C-44: login-attempt accounting hardening keeps lockout counters consistent.
- C-45: import re-key hardening avoids global secret mutation.
- C-46: full export hardening enforces scoped visibility filtering.
- C-47: forwarded-internal header trust hardening is restricted to loopback.
- C-48: plugin execution hardening enforces denylist + sandboxed template handling.
- C-49: secret comparison hardening uses `get_secret_value()` consistently.
- C-50: JSON-RPC error hardening uses stable response IDs.
- C-51: deploy command hardening validates and safely quotes plugin names.
- C-52: translate restart hardening adds restart rate-limiting.
- C-74: update-path hardening ignores client-supplied ownership fields.
- C-75: admin schema path reviewed and aligned with hardened behavior.
- C-87: LLM chat stdio transport hardening is feature-flagged off by default.
- C-88: builder subprocess hardening validates make/git argument handling.
- C-89: plugin permission-grant path hardening defaults to audit-only behavior.
- C-104: import ownership-assignment hardening scopes to active import provenance/time window.
- C-105: selective export hardening enforces scoped visibility filtering.
- S-04: gRPC target hardening applies SSRF guardrails.
- S-05: TLS path hardening validates relative-path constraints.
- S-07: provider `api_base` hardening applies SSRF validation.

commits.message:
fix: auth, RBAC, and input validation hardening (Round 2)

- Strip auth-sensitive headers from plugin pre-request hook output (C-42)
- Use direct client IP instead of spoofable X-Forwarded-For for token scoping (C-43)
- Apply lockout enforcement consistently for all accounts including admins (C-44)
- Pass encryption secret as parameter to avoid global state mutation during re-keying (C-45)
- Add team-scoped visibility filtering to export service (C-46)
- Only trust x-forwarded-internally header from loopback addresses (C-47)
- Validate plugin kind against module allowlist and use SandboxedEnvironment (C-48)
- Use get_secret_value() for SecretStr comparison in security status (C-49)
- Use correct response_id instead of builtin id in JSON-RPC error responses (C-50)
- Validate and quote plugin names in Dagger deploy commands (C-51)
- Rate-limit subprocess restarts in translate bridge (C-52)
- Validate gRPC target addresses against SSRF-unsafe destinations (S-04)
- Validate TLS cert/key paths against directory traversal (S-05)

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: gRPC target and path validation hardening, test alignment

- gRPC target validation now consults platform SSRF settings
  (ssrf_allow_localhost, ssrf_allow_private_networks, ssrf_allowed_networks,
  ssrf_blocked_networks, ssrf_blocked_hosts) for consistent behavior
- TLS path validation uses Path.is_relative_to() for correct prefix matching
- Plugin hook auth header stripping refined to only block overrides of
  existing inbound headers, preserving legitimate header transforms
- Protected admin lockout bypass preserved as feature-flagged behavior;
  failed attempt tracking now applies to all accounts for audit visibility
- Import resilience for Gunicorn --preload circular import during startup
- Test assertions aligned with hardened behavior

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: auth and provider hardening for identity and URL validation

- harden plugin auth identity resolution with DB-backed admin derivation (A-13)
- reduce sensitive auth debug metadata in tool schema assembly (A-14)
- add ORM-level encrypted token handling for oauth token columns (A-15)
- enforce ownership consistency by ignoring payload owner_email in vulnerable update paths (C-74)
- validate llm provider api_base on create/update/health-check paths using existing SSRF controls (S-07)
- update unit tests for hardened behavior and regression coverage

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
